The researchers prepared tamoxifen in corn oil and used corn-oil-only injections for the age-matched vehicle controls. Behavioral changes and neurogenesis were evaluated in the induced model. Corn oil is an actual common vehicle without a separate no-oil contrast. The injection and animal behavioral endpoints do not estimate depressive symptoms after refined corn oil consumption.

The study uses a purchased proanthocyanidin reagent in rotenone-exposed SH-SY5Y cells. The introduction mentions grape seeds as a source of these compounds and cites an earlier grape-seed experiment; the tested reagent's botanical origin is unreported. Cellular viability, oxidation and apoptosis measures supply no frozen grape exposure or clinical or animal muscle rigidity outcome.

The narrative review names saffron's dried stigma and its constituents, describes hypnotic reports and lists possible insomnia in a safety discussion. The hypnotic lead concerns a separate animal study; the adverse statement cites a toxicity review. This supplies opposing leads to trace at primary-source level. No new ground saffron or Parkinson insomnia comparison was performed by this review.

The retrospective mirror-image study compares findings before and after medical cannabis in chronic pain. Pain scores and quality of life are reported for that exposure. No dried date fruit or attributable dietary pain intervention.

The original uses multimodal brain imaging to study apathy in Parkinson disease. Clinical and anatomical associations concern the imaged cohort rather than a food intervention. No dried date exposure and no change in apathy attributable to eating dates.

The experiment assesses gene expression in prefrontal cortex of a Fabry disease mouse model. Disease-related pain is part of the clinical motivation. No dried date food administration or date-specific measured pain response.

The Cochrane synthesis distinguishes multifactorial and multiple-component fall prevention interventions in community-dwelling older adults. Fall outcomes concern the assigned prevention programs. No dried date fruit arm or separately estimated pain effects after date consumption.

This rat study assesses tanshinone IIA, a constituent associated with Danshen, alongside diabetic neuropathic pain behavior and laboratory pathways. Tanshinone is a different exposure from dried date fruit. No date food intake or pain comparison.

This Parkinson pilot randomized entire low-fat and ketogenic diets. Table 2 and the item analysis associate a larger reduction with the ketogenic plan on the combined pain and other sensations item (between-group difference −0.64 points). There was no randomized dried-date arm, verified individual dried date intake or attribution of pain effects to date fruit. Existing meal-plan and medication evidence remains linked to the same trial.

The review treats curcumin and related synthesized structures as lipoxygenase inhibitor leads. It distinguishes synthetic candidate effects from the natural constituent context. Enzyme inhibition does not measure pain severity after culinary ground turmeric or a response in Parkinson disease.

The bibliometric analysis characterizes highly cited articles about the insular cortex, including publications on pain and imaging. The report counts publications and dates. It does not test dried dates or a patient-level pain contrast.

The retrospective study analyzes cement loosening risk after vertebroplasty for osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures. Pain and functional outcomes refer to the procedure and follow-up. No date fruit exposure or attributable pain estimate.

Tiredness and sleep complaints were recorded during use of the actual blend. The reported fatigue or insomnia events cannot be attributed to fresh or dried sage. No Salvia officinalis exposure was assigned.

The experiment fed purchased cinnamaldehyde to Drosophila and measured lifespan, memory and rapid negative geotaxis. Male Tau-model flies showed improved vertical climbing, while the wild-type climbing comparison gave no clear benefit. The experiment used an isolated constituent, an Alzheimer-related insect model and a climbing task. It does not measure walking speed after ground cinnamon in Parkinson disease.

The neuroimaging study associates educational history and functional brain connectivity with executive performance in relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis. Salmon is an author surname in a citation. No poached salmon exposure or food-associated change in anxiety.

The primary compares fly food containing powdered dried fermented grape skin with standard food in PINK1-model and control flies. The standard-fed mutant group had roughly 50% abnormal wing posture, with a lower proportion at higher supplementation. The paper separately discusses olive oil in a general Mediterranean-diet description and uses figure numbers. Grape preparations are related but wing posture, activity and ATP do not isolate clinical rigidity after frozen grapes. Olive oil has dietary background only, without a cold-pressed comparison or bradykinesia measurement. Fig. denotes illustrations rather than fruit.
